title: DAEMON ACE Pre-Flight Twin Evaluation Rubric
description: A versioned sample scoring rubric for proposed cloud, GPU, Kubernetes, ROS 2 and robotics-control changes. It defines evaluation criteria and evidence requirements; it is not itself an executable simulator, certified safety standard, or proof that all listed tests are currently implemented.

environment_concepts.name: Virtual Cloud & GPU Chaos Twin
environment_concepts.description: Isolated Kubernetes and infrastructure test environments with controlled fault injection. GPU nodes may be represented by mocks or emulators unless actual GPU hardware is explicitly provisioned.

environment_concepts.name: Sim-to-Real Robotics Physics Twin
environment_concepts.description: Integration target for ROS 2 control policies and physics simulators such as Gazebo or NVIDIA Isaac Sim. A messaging smoke test is not a physics simulation.

hard_gates: Any confirmed geofence breach, actuator-limit violation, or unsafe torque command blocks robotics progression regardless of aggregate score.

Any confirmed public management interface, unintended public DDS exposure, privileged/root workload where prohibited, or wildcard IAM permission blocks cloud/edge progression regardless of aggregate score.
Missing limits, missing test evidence, or an unvalidated simulator profile must be reported as unknown, never silently treated as pass.
A passing score is evidence for human review only and never authorizes deployment or motor power.

criteria.test: Compare commanded linear velocity against an approved platform-specific max_linear_velocity limit under nominal and injected disturbances.
criteria.pass_condition: Every observed command remains within the approved limit including tolerance and sampling policy.

criteria.test: Check commanded and simulated joint torque against approved per-joint ceilings.
Inject mission load and battery-state disturbances and evaluate reserve floor policy.
criteria.pass_condition: Policy prevents continuation below the approved reserve floor.

criteria.test: Exercise boundary, localization-noise and obstacle-edge cases.
criteria.pass_condition: No commanded or simulated trajectory crosses the configured safety boundary.

criteria.test: Verify DDS discovery and transport are restricted to explicitly approved interfaces and peers. A loopback-only profile may require 127.0.0.1; distributed ROS 2 deployments require an explicitly approved isolated network rather than blindly forcing loopback.
criteria.pass_condition: No unintended public discovery or unapproved peer communication is possible.

criteria.test: Inspect pod/container security contexts for privileged mode, root UID and privilege escalation.
criteria.pass_condition: Workloads comply with the approved non-root and least-privilege baseline.

criteria.test: Evaluate IAM actions, resources, principals, trust relationships and wildcard permissions against a customer-approved policy baseline.
criteria.pass_condition: No unapproved wildcard or excessive permission remains.

criteria.test: Inject controlled memory pressure and observe scheduling, restart behavior, service health and recovery.
criteria.pass_condition: Workload remains within defined SLO and recovers within agreed thresholds.

criteria.test: Evaluate GPU allocation, MIG profile compatibility where supported, quotas and node capacity.
criteria.pass_condition: No unsupported partition claim, oversubscription or unapproved capacity contention.

criteria.test: Inject pod, node or network failures in an isolated test environment.
criteria.pass_condition: Fault remains within the defined blast radius and recovery objectives.

criteria.test: Compare proposed resource changes against explicit budget, quota and cost ceilings.
criteria.pass_condition: No configured spend ceiling or quota is exceeded.

criteria.test: Evaluate utilization and autoscaling behavior against workload-specific targets.
criteria.pass_condition: Scaling remains within cost and capacity bounds without sustained starvation.

criteria.test: Compare CPU, memory and GPU allocation to workload demand and baseline.
criteria.pass_condition: No unjustified allocation increase or starvation regression.

criteria.test: Record model identifier, prompt or policy version, input digest, source commit and test environment.
criteria.pass_condition: Evidence can be traced to the evaluated proposal and environment.

criteria.test: Attach proposed remediation diff and before/after evaluation evidence.
criteria.pass_condition: Changes are reviewable and linked to findings.

criteria.test: Require named authorized reviewer, decision, timestamp and scope before progression.
criteria.pass_condition: No production or hardware progression without recorded approval.

integrity.note: A digest is not a digital signature. Production signing requires a managed signing key, key custody policy and verification process.

currently_demonstrated_in_repository: ROS 2 DDS and velocity text-pattern checks in the existing preflight scanner
Ephemeral kind Kubernetes cluster creation and basic workload scheduling check in the new CI workflow
not_yet_implemented_or_not_yet_verified: Gazebo or NVIDIA Isaac Sim physics integration
robot dynamics, torque, battery and geofence enforcement
GPU chaos injection on real GPU nodes
MIG partition orchestration and measured GPU optimization
deterministic model action scoring and RLHF/RLAIF export pipeline
cryptographic signing and verification of receipts
implementation_disclosure.safety_notice: This rubric is a proposed evaluation framework. Values, thresholds, test profiles and acceptance criteria must be approved for each robot, workload and customer environment by qualified owners. It does not constitute a safety certification, formal audit, or authorization to deploy.
